path_policy: Inherited display_path preserves interior .. without probing whether lib is a symlink. The supplied nested hidden filename remains eligible for the standard *Fastfile exemption; Ruby File.expand_path instead collapses to root .Fastfile, which is not exempt. Collapsing here would change alias-sensitive path policy, not repair the actual basename (which is .Fastfile in both).
